question: Mendeleev's Periodic Law states that:

options.text: the properties of elements are the periodic function of their atomic masses
the properties of elements are the periodic function of their atomic numbers
the properties of elements are the periodic function of their colour
the properties of elements are the periodic function of their magnetic properties

solution:
The correct answer is__** option 1) ​the properties of elements are the periodic function of their atomic masses**__

**This law was proposed by Russian chemist Dmitri Mendeleev in the late 19th century and is a fundamental principle in the development of the periodic table of elements.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Mendeleev arranged the known chemical elements into a table based on their atomic masses and observed that elements with similar properties recurred at regular intervals.
 
• This periodic arrangement eventually led to the modern periodic table, which is organized based on the atomic number of elements (the number of protons in an atom's nucleus) rather than atomic mass.
 
• Mendeleev's work laid the foundation for our understanding of the periodic table and the organization of the chemical elements.
 
• Mendeleev grouped elements with similar chemical properties into vertical columns or groups.
 
• Mendeleev's table did not include noble gases since they were not discovered yet. These elements were later incorporated into the modern periodic table after their discovery.
